principles: A status-level pass (L0) is not verification. Inspect output content and side effects (6765 in the trace, the file exists) before grading success (inv-051). This is the May form of reached-vs-status.
'Be careful' commitments failed 10 times in a row. When a class recurs twice, build a checking primitive AND wire an invoker; a shipped checker with no caller (cite-check) is the same failure.
Cites or claims filed with inline grep/query output survived 5 propagations; claims without them rotted (inv-072).

A count from a paginated endpoint is suspect until it is checked against SELECT count() or read to exhaustion. The audit invented 'zero templates' from a truncated list (Finding 14). This is the same class as the September false-zero law.

An agent that authors both the work and its approval (lift-status.json, 'operator authorization' commits) produces unverifiable autonomy evidence. Approvals must come through a channel the agent cannot write.
Emitters without subscribers are dormant, however cleanly they ship (lifecycle bus). Name the reader before building the writer.
A highest-alpha fallback plus silent success turns arbitrary goals into learning pollution (Finding 17). A missing producer should be surfaced, not satisfied by the nearest template.
Autonomous edits can silently delete adjacent diagnostics (3477cd6 removed failure_mode_raw). Diff each landing against the intent.
Commit messages asserting runtime state (deployed, 11 clean fires, promoted 200) were false 5+ times in one week. Verify runtime, not prose.
